name: Entity Deep Token
description: Adds an entity-deep-token token type that reads values from fields of related entities across multiple reference hops.
project_description: Entity Deep Token adds a custom token type, entity-deep-token, that resolves values from fields of related entities by walking entity-reference chains across multiple levels of depth. Drupal's built-in token system only follows one-level relationships; this module lets a token hop from a source entity through one or more entity-reference fields (each :entity: step) and read a terminal property such as id, label, bundle, value, target_id, or date on the entity reached at the end of the chain. The set of source entity types the module reacts to is chosen on an admin settings form (route entity_deep_token.settings, permission administer site configuration), which stores a content_list config value in entity_deep_token.settings. It depends on the Token module and is intended for site builders and developers who need referenced-entity values in any token-aware context (breadcrumbs, metadata, URL patterns, conditional logic). Current limitations from the source: only the first delta of a multi-value reference field is followed, and raw values (for example timestamps) are returned unformatted.
